page.overview:
Who is Fairuz Fauzy?

Mohamed Fairuz Fauzy (born October 24, 1982) is a Malaysian racing driver.

He was confirmed as one of 's reserve drivers for the season. Fauzy got his big break when he took part in five practice sessions during the season for the team, including his home round. In four of those, he replaced Heikki Kovalainen. Fauzy was the second Malaysian at a Grand Prix weekend following Alex Yoong in -.
